policy: Candidate routes are research-stage exact legal scopes. They do not become publishable pathways until they receive canonical pathway ids, complete material evidence, and pass the normal promotion gate.

candidates.name: Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189) — Points-tested stream
candidates.scopeNote: Exact subclass 189 scope. Do not promote the AU-skilled umbrella or infer subclass 190/491 eligibility. The current financial record is an explicit research-gap finding, not a promotion proof.

candidates.name: Skilled Migrant Category — Skilled Work Experience pathway
candidates.scopeNote: Exact child route. Requires final occupation/exception validation and full promotion-gate testing before canonicalization.

candidates.name: Skilled Migrant Category — Trades and Technician pathway
candidates.scopeNote: Exact child route. Requires final eligible-occupation and qualification matrix validation before canonicalization.

candidates.name: Red-White-Red Card — Other Key Workers
candidates.scopeNote: Exact sub-route candidate; do not treat evidence as proof for other Red-White-Red categories.

candidates.name: 2026 non-seasonal subordinate work — Flussi route
candidates.scopeNote: Temporal 2026 quota/process candidate; employer nulla-osta, sector/country quota treatment and applicant-side evidence remain separate promotion gates.

candidates.name: Skilled Migrant Category — Points-based pathway
candidates.scopeNote: Canonical child-route candidate identified by current SMC architecture; full current eligibility, financial and process evidence remains to be collected before promotion.
